content.text: Every creator in a platform-restricted country eventually arrives at the same moment: the application rejected, the payout held, the account flagged for no stated reason. Stripe does not support your country. PayPal's compliance engine decided your location is high-risk. Gumroad cannot pay you because Stripe cannot move the money. These are not bugs. They are the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products|The Real]]-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-works-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-software-without-stripe-account|architecture]] working exactly as designed — for a specific set of markets, and against yours. The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
